name: Suzlon Energy Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest wind-turbine OEM (22+ GW installed in 17 countries): turbine manufacturing (S144 3.15 MW; S175 5 MW and 6.3 MW being launched), project development/Devco, O&M (Suzlon Global Services) and forgings/castings (SE Forge); acquired Renom (O&M). Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 4,869 cr (+26%), record 710 MW deliveries, EBITDA Rs 720 cr (margin 14.8% vs 18.6%), comparable PAT Rs 394 cr (+1.3%; reported -69% on year-ago Rs 891 cr deferred tax credit). Order book 6 GW (18 months), net cash Rs 2,048 cr, net worth Rs 10,277 cr. FY27 EBITDA margin guidance cut to ~15% +/-1% from ~17%. Stock hit a 52w low Rs 33.2 on 30 Oct 2026 after the print.

revenue_mix.geography: India ~99%; exports yet to start (BlueSky platform awaiting certification)

exposures.mechanism: Order flow depends on India's 500 GW non-fossil push, C&I/IPP wind-hybrid auctions, transmission and ALMM-style local-content support. +1 = stronger support -> wind installations +10% in FY28-29 -> WTG revenue +10% at ~21% contribution margin; EBITDA +14% (leverage 1.4x); EV/MCap 0.95 (net cash Rs 2,048 cr); persistence 0.6 -> +8, trimmed for the 18-month order cover already in price -> +7.

evidence.note: Order book 6 GW (18 months cover); 1.5 GW new orders in H1 FY27; 900 MW via Devco model

exposures.mechanism: JM Financial downgraded to 'Add' citing margin sustainability, competition and growth after FY28. WTG contribution margin already fell to 21.2% from 26.9% on customer/scope mix. +1 = realised WTG price per MW -5% (more competition from Envision, Adani, Inox Wind, global OEM entries): WTG ~80% of revenue x 5% = 4% revenue at ~100% drop-through -> EBITDA margin 14.8% -> ~11%, EBITDA -27%; EV/MCap 0.95; persistence 0.4 (partly offset by cost-out) -> -9.7, trimmed -> -8.

evidence.note: JM Financial downgrade on margin sustainability, competition and growth post FY28

exposures.mechanism: Towers, hubs, castings and forgings are ~20% of COGS (COGS ~85% of revenue -> steel ~17% of revenue); order contracts fix prices with limited escalation, ~60% unprotected until re-pricing. +7% domestic steel -> +1.2% of revenue x 60% = 0.7% / 15% margin = EBITDA -4.8%; EV/MCap 0.95; persistence 0.4 -> -1.8. Empirical on global HRC -2.44 per +10% (t -2.0) is consistent (7% domestic ~ 10% global x 0.7 pass-through).

evidence.note: Management cites commodity and FX volatility behind margin cut

exposures.mechanism: Generator windings, cables, converters use copper (~4% of revenue); +10% -> +0.4% of revenue, 60% unprotected -> 0.24%/15% = EBITDA -1.6%; x0.95 x 0.4 -> -0.6; blended with empirical -1.80 (t -1.7), partly a cyclical-beta proxy -> -0.9.

Imported gearbox/bearing/electronics and Renom/European content est. ~25% of COGS; sales in INR; management names forex among the margin headwinds. +3% -> +0.64% of revenue, 50% hedged/passed -> 0.3%/15% = EBITDA -2.1%; x0.95 x 0.5 -> -1.0; empirical -2.06 (t -0.9) -> -1.2.

evidence.note: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance cut to ~15% +/-1% on commodity and FX pressure, West Asia crisis

exposures.mechanism: Management attributes margin pressure to the West Asia crisis via commodity and FX volatility. +1 escalation -> steel/copper/oil-derived resin and freight up, rupee down; EBITDA margin another -100 bp (-7% EBITDA) x 0.95 x 0.3 -> -2.

evidence.note: Commodity and FX pressure, particularly from the West Asia crisis

exposures.mechanism: Net cash, so earnings channel is small, but wind economics for IPP/C&I buyers are rate-sensitive (project IRR down ~30 bp per +25 bp) -> orders -1.5% and a high-beta (1.5) retail-heavy stock (promoters 11.7%, public 54%) de-rates on rates; -2.

evidence.note: Net cash Rs 2,048 cr; Crisil AA- stable

exposures.mechanism: Faster electricity demand lifts RE procurement by discoms/C&I. +3 pp demand growth -> annual RE auctions +4% -> orders +3%; EBITDA +4%; x0.95 x 0.6 -> +2.3, trimmed -> +1.5.

evidence.note: 1.25 GW erected turbines pipeline; 6 GW order book

exposures.mechanism: Data-centre operators contract RE capacity via C&I wind-hybrid PPAs. +1 = data-centre capex 20% above plan -> C&I wind orders +5% -> +1.5.

evidence.note: Pack headlines: Rs 550 cr investment plan (12 Oct), MOFSL Buy TP Rs 65

supply_chain.counterparty: IPPs, C&I buyers (Jindal Renewables, Adani Green, Torrent, etc.)
supply_chain.note: No single customer verified >25% in this run

supply_chain.counterparty: Envision, Adani Wind, Inox Wind, global OEMs

First S175 5 MW commercial installations and export-order milestone (BlueSky certifications)
Additional large order wins (1.5 GW added in H1)
Margin trajectory: FY27 guidance ~15% +/-1% test in Q3

current_state.trend: Volume records, margin compressing (WTG contribution 26.9% -> 21.2%); guidance cut.

Growth visibility post FY28 and export delay

S175/6.3 MW platform wins and first exports
